ORDINANCE VIII OF 2001
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE FEE FOR RENEWAL OF CERTIFICATE (BOILERS)
RULES, 1999
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 17th March, 2001]
No.SOIV/IND/2-29/99, dated 14-12-1999.---Whereas, it is expedient
that the existing rates of tee of renewal of certificate for Boilers be revised
and updated: and
Whereas the competent authority
has approved the revised rates of fee of renewal for the Boilers, as
hereinafter contained:
Now, therefore, in exercise of
the powers conferred by clause (f) of section 29 of the Boiler Act 1923 (Act V
of 1923), the Government of the North-West Frontier Province, is pleased to
make the following rules:--
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) These rules may be called
the North-West Frontier Province Fee for Renewal of Certificate (Boilers)
Rules, 1999.
(2) They shall come into force at
once.
2. Notwithstanding anything to
the contrary contained in any rules for the tune being in force, the fees for
inspection of Boilers shall be calculated on the basis of Boilers ratings as specified
hereunder:--.
(a) Boiler rating not exceeding
100 square feet.
Rs.600
(b) Boiler rating exceeding 100
square feet but not exceeding 300 square feet.
Rs.720
(c) Boiler rating exceeding 300
square feet but not exceeding 500 square feet.
Rs. 750
(d) Boiler rating exceeding 500
square feet but not exceeding 700 square feet.
Rs.1,200
(e) Boiler rating exceeding 700
square feet but not exceeding 900 square feet.
Rs.1,350
(f) Boiler rating exceeding 990
square feet but not exceeding 1100 square feet.
Rs.1.800
(g) Boiler rating exceeding
110() square feet but not exceeding 2000 square feet.
Rs.2.000
(h) Boiler rating exceeding
2000 square feet but not exceeding 4000 square feet.
Rs.2.200
(i) Boiler rating exceeding
4000 square feet but not exceeding 6000 square feet.
Rs. 2,500
(j) Boiler rating exceeding
6000 square feet but not exceeding 8000 square feet.
Rs.3.400
(k) Boiler rating exceeding
8000 square feet but not exceeding 10000 square feet.
Rs.3.800
(l) Boiler rating exceeding
10000 square feet
Rs.4,200
